confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors are the better-grounded part; hotel and hostel rates vary with season and events, so they are least certain. Beer assumes a 0.5 L draft pour. Cocktail and wine glass were set from the beer anchor at about 2.7 and 1.4 times, because direct price knowledge for Brno bars is weak. FX: the 2026-10-15 figure comes from search summaries that attribute it to the RBA overview page. A later check could not reproduce it on the RBA table, so verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Brno is the Czech Republic's second-largest city and usually cheaper than Prague, so anchors sit below Prague levels. Benchmarked against mid-sized Central European cities with similar tourism demand, such as Krakow and Bratislava, with July lodging demand considered.
